issues.description: Prohibited template placeholder: `url = ""  # CI fills this`. Code style rule 5 explicitly lists this pattern as a forbidden template placeholder that should be filled by the adapter before merge. The recipe url field should point to where this Conan recipe is hosted (e.g. the cnb.cool repo URL) or be removed if not applicable.
issues.fix_suggestion: Set url to the actual recipe repository URL (e.g. "https://cnb.cool/your-group/your-repo/-/tree/main/archives/l/libieee1284/0.2.11") or remove the url attribute entirely if the project does not host recipes in a separate repo.

issues.description: Generated file modified at build time: `self.run("sed -i 's/umask 077/umask 022/g' configure", cwd=self.source_folder)` modifies the autoconf-generated `configure` script. Rule R6 prohibits modifying generated files (configure, Makefile.in, etc.). However, this is a pragmatic platform adaptation (E011: HMDFS permission compatibility) — the configure file is excluded from the patch system by refresh-patch because it detects "Generated by" markers, making sed the only viable method. No deception is involved. Classified as P2 (warning) rather than P1 (must-fail) per the pragmatic adaptation rationale.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a comment explaining why sed is used instead of a patch file (already partially present). Consider if a future refresh-patch update could support configure patches. For now, the sed approach is acceptable as a documented platform workaround.

issues.description: Patch list (补丁列表) in notes.md has incorrect patch numbering and names that do not match the actual patch files. notes.md lists: (1) 0001-config.guess.patch, (2) 0002-config.sub.patch, (3) 0003-configure.patch, (4) access_io.c修改, (5) detect.c修改. The actual patches are: 0001-src-access_io.c.patch, 0002-src-detect.c.patch, 0003-config.guess.patch, 0004-config.sub.patch. Additionally, notes.md states the umask fix was done via 'patch 0003' when it is actually done via sed in build(). The test-report.md correctly documents the sed approach, but notes.md is inconsistent.
issues.fix_suggestion: Update the 补丁列表 section in notes.md to match the actual patch files: (1) 0001-src-access_io.c.patch, (2) 0002-src-detect.c.patch, (3) 0003-config.guess.patch, (4) 0004-config.sub.patch. Change the umask fix description from 'patch 0003' to 'sed in build() (E011)' to match the actual implementation and test-report.md.

issues.description: Unused import: `import os` is imported but only referenced in a commented-out line (line 33). The active code path does not use the os module.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the `import os` line, or uncomment the alternative test execution line if it is intended as a fallback.

issues.description: Test always returns 0 regardless of API result. While the test does call the real API (ieee1284_find_ports/ieee1284_free_ports) and is NOT an empty shell test (R34 pass), the test cannot distinguish between success and failure — it returns 0 even when ieee1284_find_ports returns a negative error code. This is a weak test, acceptable for a hardware-dependent library on a platform without parallel ports, but could be strengthened.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider returning a non-zero exit code if ieee1284_find_ports returns an unexpected error (e.g. E1284_NOTAVAIL vs E1284_INVALIDARG). For now, the current behavior is acceptable since HarmonyOS PC has no parallel port hardware.

issues.description: Redundant case pattern: the second pattern `aarch64-*-linux-ohos)` is a subset of the first pattern `*-linux-ohos)`, making the second case branch dead code that can never be reached.
issues.fix_suggestion: Remove the redundant `aarch64-*-linux-ohos)` case branch, or restructure to handle aarch64 specifically if different behavior is intended.

issues.description: notes.md mentions a pre-compiled package name: '预编译包：libieee1284-0.2.11-ohos-aarch64.tar.gz ✅'. While no binary files are included in the PR (R19 pass), this documentation reference to a pre-compiled artifact could be misleading. The PR should only reference source-built artifacts.
issues.fix_suggestion: Rephrase to '本地构建产物验证：libieee1284-0.2.11-ohos-aarch64 (CI build) ✅' to clarify this is a CI-built artifact, not a pre-compiled binary included in the PR.

summary: Audit of libieee1284 0.2.11 Conan recipe — VERDICT: PASS. No P0 (deception) or P1 (correctness must-fail) issues found. The recipe is functionally correct: Conan 2.x API usage is proper, source URL is official (SourceForge), sha256 is valid, test_package calls real API (ieee1284_find_ports/ieee1284_free_ports — R34 compliant), cmake.test() is not skipped (R9 compliant), manifest status 'built' is consistent with test report (R3 compliant), no pre-compiled binaries in PR (R19 compliant), patches contain substantive platform adaptation logic (R40 compliant). Three P2 warnings: (1) url="" # CI fills this template placeholder should be filled (CS-5), (2) sed modifying generated configure file is a pragmatic HMDFS workaround classified as P2 per task instructions (R6), (3) notes.md patch list has incorrect numbering/names and misstates umask fix method as patch vs sed. Four P3 hints: unused import os in test_package, weak test always returning 0, redundant case pattern in config.sub patch, and pre-compiled package name mention in notes.md. All issues are non-blocking style/documentation concerns.
